expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, the page has no horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth at most 320)
expectations.evidence: Chromium 320px: documentElement.scrollWidth = 320 (400px: 400); the pre scrolls inside its own box (scrollWidth 672 vs clientWidth 286) and the table ends at x=304.

expectations.text: Body paragraphs in the article compute hyphens: auto
expectations.evidence: All 2 article p compute hyphens: auto at 320px and 400px.

expectations.text: Inline code and pre do not hyphenate: they compute hyphens none or manual
expectations.evidence: Computed hyphens at 320px: inline code none, pre auto, pre>code none. CSS sets hyphens: none on .doc code only; the pre inherits hyphens: auto from .doc.

expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, every value cell in the settings table renders on a single line, so no number is split from its unit
expectations.evidence: At 320px each value cell's text Range gives 1 client rect on 1 line box (2,5 GB, 1 500 kr, 30 dagar, 12 h; text height 18px vs line-height 24px); value column is white-space: nowrap.

expectations.text: Body paragraphs are not justified (computed text-align is start or left)
expectations.evidence: All article p compute text-align: start.

expectations.text: At a 320px viewport, the h1 does not overflow its own box (its scrollWidth is no larger than its clientWidth)
expectations.evidence: At 320px h1 scrollWidth 288 = clientWidth 288 (font-size 24px, height 57.59375px, wraps via hyphenation).
